caption: The drawing depicts a large, brown ceramic jar with a wide mouth and two small handles on either side near the top. The jar is vertically oriented and has a smooth, rounded body with a slightly flared rim. Three horizontal lines encircle the upper portion of the jar as decorative bands, with two additional lines near the bottom. Etched into the surface of the jar is a simple line drawing of a bird in profile, with a round eye and a pointed beak facing to the right. The bird is standing upright, and its two legs extend down to a circular feature near the base of the jar. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border. The overall color of the jar is a reddish-brown with darker shading to suggest depth and curvature.
title: Water Cooler
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
